backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing inventory, challans, payments, petty cash, and client management with access control, user approval system, blob storage, and migration support. Includes CRUD operations, bulk operations, and query methods for all entities.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that drops legacy approvalState, bootstrapAdmins, and userProfiles fields from old actor state during upgrades.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting removal of Internet Identity authentication, AuthApprovalGate, admin role checks, and related authentication/authorization logic from frontend components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including pages, components, hooks, and styles, describing their functionality after authentication removal and feature updates.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT_CHECKLIST.md: Deployment verification checklist with build/deploy commands, critical inventory add item test flow, and in-app diagnostics guide for troubleshooting connection and actor initialization issues.
frontend/index.css: Empty CSS file (content truncated or not present).
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with CSP meta tag allowing ICP domains, external CDNs, and Internet Identity frame sources, mounting React app to #root div.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component defining TanStack Router with routes for dashboard, inventory, challans, payments, petty cash, client balances, and reports, wrapped in AppLayout and error boundary with runtime diagnostics initialization.
frontend/src/components/challans/Challan: Dialog component for bulk uploading challans via CSV file, with validation, parsing, error display, and staff permission checks. Handles file selection, CSV parsing, validation errors, and displays upload results with success/failure counts.

Dialog component for editing existing challans with form fields for client, venue, dates, freight, and line items. Validates inventory availability, prevents editing returned challans, and calculates rental days and totals.

Dialog component for creating new challans with form inputs for challan ID, client details, rental dates, and multiple line items. Includes real-time inventory validation and automatic calculation of rental days and item totals.

Dialog component for bulk uploading challans using a new CSV format, with parsing, validation, and staff permission checks. Similar to ChallanBulkUploadDialog but uses a different CSV parser for the new format.

Dialog component for restoring challan rent and return dates from an original CSV file upload. Supports both legacy and new CSV formats with validation, error handling, and staff permission restrictions.
frontend/src/components/clients/ClientBu: Dialog component for bulk uploading clients from CSV files. Parses CSV data, validates client names for duplicates, and uses the bulk create mutation to upload multiple clients at once with success/failure reporting.
frontend/src/components/common/AppErrorB: React error boundary that catches render-time errors and displays a fallback UI with expandable technical details and a diagnostics report copy button. Includes reset functionality to reload the application.
frontend/src/components/common/ApprovalR: Disabled approval screen component that returns null (authentication removed).
frontend/src/components/common/AuthAppro: Pass-through wrapper component that renders children directly (authentication removed).
frontend/src/components/common/BuildInfo: Sheet panel displaying build metadata, backend connection diagnostics, health monitoring, and manual connection/auth testing with troubleshooting guidance. Includes integration with diagnostics reporting and runtime error logging.
frontend/src/components/common/BulkUploa: Reusable UI components for bulk upload workflows including steps display, template download button, validation button, and preview section with error/success alerts.
frontend/src/components/common/Diagnosti: Dialog that displays a formatted diagnostics report in a read-only textarea with copy-to-clipboard and clear log functionality.
frontend/src/components/common/ModalSele: Wrapper around SelectContent that ensures proper scrolling, z-index handling, and collision detection when used inside modal dialogs.
frontend/src/components/common/QueryErro: Reusable error display component for query failures with retry button, authentication prompt, expandable troubleshooting steps, and technical details using error classification utilities.
frontend/src/components/common/SignInReq: A disabled sign-in dialog component that returns null, indicating authentication has been removed from the application.
frontend/src/components/common/SignInScr: A disabled sign-in screen component that returns null, indicating authentication has been removed from the application.
frontend/src/components/inventory/Invent: Dialog component for bulk uploading inventory items via CSV file, with CSV parsing, validation, staff permission checks, error reporting, and batch creation functionality.
Dialog form for adding or editing inventory items with validation, mutation gating, actor readiness checks, sign-in prompts on authorization failures, and inline error handling.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Main application layout component with header navigation (Dashboard, Inventory, Challans, Payments, Petty Cash, Client Balances, Reports), footer with branding, and conditional rendering for print routes.
frontend/src/components/payments/Payment: Dialog component for bulk uploading payments via CSV file, with CSV parsing using utility functions, validation against existing payments, staff permission checks, and batch creation with result reporting.
Dialog form for adding new payment records with fields for payment ID, date, client selection, payment mode, amount, reference number, and site.
frontend/src/components/petty-cash/Petty: Component for managing petty cash attachments (images and PDFs) with file upload, validation (type and size), local upload state tracking, and removal functionality using ExternalBlob for file handling.
Dialog component for bulk uploading petty cash records from CSV files, with template download, validation, error reporting, and staff permission checks.
Dialog form for creating/editing individual petty cash records with dynamic category expenses, attachments, cash received calculation, and PDF generation support.
frontend/src/hooks/useAccessManagement.t: React Query hooks for admin access management including checking admin status, listing user approvals, and setting approval statuses.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance with identity-based authentication and automatic query invalidation on actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActorWithConnectio: Enhanced actor hook with connectivity probing, exponential backoff retry logic, connection state management, and diagnostic tracking for anonymous actor initialization.
frontend/src/hooks/useAppMode.ts: Hook that detects whether the app is running on admin or staff domain based on hostname pattern (presence of '-x18').
frontend/src/hooks/useApprovalStatus.ts: Stub hooks that always return approved/admin status true, effectively disabling the approval system.
frontend/src/hooks/useBootstrapAdmin.ts: No-op hook that returns success state, effectively disabling admin bootstrapping functionality.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout flow, identity persistence, and delegation validity checking.
frontend/src/hooks/useMutationGate.ts: Hook that gates mutations based on actor connection readiness, returning state about whether mutations can proceed and connection status messages.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all CRUD operations (inventory, challans, payments, petty cash, clients) including bulk operations, with automatic cache invalidation and actor-based backend calls.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueryDataVersion.t: Helper hook that returns a serializable version string based on React Query cache timestamps to avoid BigInt serialization errors in queryKeys.
Hook that returns unrestricted permissions (all operations allowed) for bulk uploads and deletions.
frontend/src/hooks/useTodayKey.ts: Hook that returns a stable YYYY-MM-DD date string and automatically updates at midnight to trigger date-aware query invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system for light/dark themes and comprehensive Radix Dialog opacity fixes to ensure fully opaque modal backgrounds.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
Displays an alert indicating that the access management system has been disabled and all users have full access.
frontend/src/pages/ChallanDetailPage.tsx: Displays detailed challan information with edit, delete, and print actions; locks returned challans from modification and enforces staff restrictions.
frontend/src/pages/ChallanPrintPage.tsx: Renders a print-optimized challan view with company header, client details, items table, and totals; auto-triggers browser print dialog on load.
frontend/src/pages/ChallansPage.tsx: Main challans list page with create, bulk upload, restore dates, and mark-returned actions; includes authentication gating and staff restriction checks.
frontend/src/pages/ClientBalancesPage.ts: Displays a table of client balances showing total rent, payments, outstanding amounts, and advances for each client. Fetches data using useClientBalances hook and formats currency values.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Dashboard page showing daily, monthly, and all-time metrics including revenue, challan counts, payments (cash/online), expenses, and inventory status. Uses useInventory and useDashboardMetrics hooks to fetch and display data in metric cards.
frontend/src/pages/InventoryPage.tsx: Manages rental inventory items with CRUD operations, displaying a table of items with quantities (total, issued, available) and daily rates. Includes dialogs for adding/editing items and bulk upload functionality.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentsPage.tsx: Displays and manages payment records in a table showing date, client, payment mode, amount, and reference number. Includes staff restrictions for bulk upload and a form dialog for adding new payments.
frontend/src/pages/PettyCashPage.tsx: Tracks daily petty cash transactions showing opening/closing balances, cash from MD, expenses, staff advances, and handovers. Supports PDF generation for records and bulk upload with staff restrictions.
frontend/src/pages/ReportsPage.tsx: Comprehensive reporting page with filters for date ranges (daily/monthly/custom), clients, sites, and status. Displays challans, payments, and petty cash data in tabs with Excel export functionality and date validation for custom ranges.
frontend/src/utils/challanExportTemplate: Builds challan export data as a 2D array with headers and item-level rows, repeating challan-level fields (ID, client, venue, dates, freight, total, status) for each item in the challan.
frontend/src/utils/challanImport.ts: Parses legacy challan CSV format with one item per row (columns: Challan ID, Client Name, Venue, Item Name, Quantity, Rate, Start Date, End Date, Freight), validates data, and groups rows by challan ID into Challan objects.
frontend/src/utils/challanImportNewForma: Parses new challan CSV format with one challan per row and multiple items in a single 'Items' column, supporting both parentheses format (ItemName(qtyxratexdays)) and colon format (ItemName:qty:rate) for item tokens.
Parses challan restore CSV for date restoration, supporting both legacy (Start Date/End Date) and new (Rent Date/Return Date) formats, validating dates and creating minimal Challan objects with only ID and date fields.
frontend/src/utils/challanTotals.ts: Provides shared calculation utilities for challan totals: item total (quantity × rate × rental days), challan total (items total + freight), and form-based total calculations for create/edit dialogs.
frontend/src/utils/clientImport.ts: Parses client CSV (single 'Name' column), validates client names for emptiness and duplicates (both in existing clients and within the upload file), and returns valid Client objects with creation timestamps.
frontend/src/utils/csv.ts: Generic CSV parser that handles standard quoting rules, escaped quotes, UTF-8 BOM, CRLF line endings, and multi-line quoted fields, returning headers and rows as string arrays.
frontend/src/utils/dashboardMetrics.ts: Calculates dashboard metrics (revenue, payments, expenses, cash in hand) for given time periods, filtering challans by rent date and payments by creation date, with separate future metrics calculation.
frontend/src/utils/dates.ts: Provides date utility functions for converting between JavaScript Date objects and bigint nanosecond timestamps, parsing date strings in multiple formats, normalizing dates, and calculating rental days.
frontend/src/utils/diagnosticsReport.ts: Generates comprehensive diagnostics reports tracking authentication events, backend connection probes, response times, and browser capabilities with troubleshooting guidance.
frontend/src/utils/errors.ts: Classifies errors into categories (actor-unavailable, authorization, network, timeout, etc.) and provides normalized error messages with troubleshooting guidance for each category.
frontend/src/utils/exportToCSV.ts: Provides functions to download CSV templates for inventory, challans, payments, petty cash, and clients with predefined headers.
frontend/src/utils/exportToExcel.ts: Exports report data (challans, payments, petty cash, client balances, summary) to Excel format using dynamically loaded SheetJS library, creating multiple worksheets with formatted data.
frontend/src/utils/paymentImport.ts: Parses and validates CSV files for payment imports, checking for duplicate IDs, validating dates/amounts/required fields, and returning valid Payment objects plus error details for invalid rows.
frontend/src/utils/pettyCashImport.ts: Parses and validates petty cash CSV imports with required columns (date, opening balance, cash from MD, expenses, etc.), checks for duplicate dates, parses category expenses, and calculates closing balances.
frontend/src/utils/pettyCashPdf.ts: Generates PDF documents for petty cash records using pdf-lib loaded from CDN, creating formatted A4 pages with tables showing opening/closing balances, cash flows, and expenses.
frontend/src/utils/reportExportFormatter: Provides shared Excel export formatting helpers for converting bigint nanosecond timestamps to date strings, formatting currency to 2 decimals, and normalizing text fields.
frontend/src/utils/runtimeDiagnostics.ts: Tracks runtime diagnostics including actor initialization, authentication lifecycle, connection probes, and errors with context (timestamp, user agent, path), persisting up to 100 entries to sessionStorage for troubleshooting.
frontend/src/utils/safeSerialize.ts: Provides safe JSON serialization helpers that convert BigInt to strings to prevent serialization errors, with functions for stringifying values and extracting error details.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support and functions to clear parameters from URLs.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration file defining custom color schemes using OKLCH color space, container settings, border radius variables, accordion animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file documenting the RentIQ property management application's migration to a fully public system by removing all Internet Identity authentication, admin roles, user approvals, and access control from both frontend and backend.
